notes.title: Expanding the World, Deepening the Mystery – Developer Diary #7 🕵️‍♂️
notes.content:
[url=https://discord.gg/theenigmacases][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121231/eaa26ff2ac7ba97b2321d38e64dfec1ebdeb0547.png[/img]
[/url]

[h1][b]Hello, Detectives! 🕵️‍♂️[/b][/h1]

Welcome to our seventh devlog for The Enigma Cases! We’re excited to share some major updates and progress we’ve made on the game.

First off The Enigma Cases has officially surpassed 70,000 wishlists on Steam! 🎉

As indie developers, we can't thank you enough. Your support through wishlists, comments, and feedback continues to inspire and guide us every step of the way.

[h1][b]Release Plans & What's Coming Next! 📅 [/b][/h1]

We're currently aiming to release The Enigma Cases in Q3 2025. Before the early access, we plan to launch a free prologue that will give players a first glimpse into the world, mechanics, and atmosphere of the game. Your feedback on the prologue will be instrumental in helping us polish and finalize the main game.

[h1][b]CO-OP Features 🤝 [/b][/h1]

Another exciting part of development: we’re actively working on CO-OP functionality for The Enigma Cases.

We believe that solving mysteries together can add a whole new layer of immersion and enjoyment to the experience.  we’re now expanding this to support up to 4 players. This will open the door for richer teamwork, new strategic dynamics, and shared discoveries

[h2][b]Investigation Board System 🗂️[/b][/h2]

The Investigation Board has been refined to give players full freedom over how they organize their case.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121231/5e6902582564460f3e1743cfb7898a39551e8782.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Clue Combination System 🧩 [/b][/h2]

We’ve made the Clue Combination System smoother, faster, and more intuitive especially for 
co-op play. Players can now easily drag, drop, and test combinations without clunky UI interruptions or waiting on others.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121231/d0c59010029c1f533443c846b2f301d60f358052.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Vehicle System 🚗 [/b][/h2]

As the scale of our open world grows, so does the need for meaningful traversal and that’s where the Vehicle System comes in.

In The Enigma Cases, players will be able to hop into their police vehicle and drive across the city to investigate new locations, respond to leads, or follow suspects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121231/be7b84b07da4b20de25d5a7d4cbec508fdb1936e.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Expanding the World, Deepening the Mystery! 🌍[/b][/h1]

Based on community input and our evolving creative vision, we’ve made a major shift in our development focus:

We’ve decided to expand the open world design and enhance the depth of the narrative.

We want The Enigma Cases to offer a compelling and immersive experience for players who love story-rich detective games with mystery, atmosphere, and meaningful exploration. Expect a more dynamic world, layered storytelling, and deeper character interactions that enrich the investigative experience.

This direction allows us to create a living, breathing mystery one that reacts to your curiosity and rewards your attention to detail.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121231/a0770015042c14aae01abad6a6f6833dca2dda09.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121231/d2473290ce704a6ee3de485f026fabfd16c55eea.png[/img]

[h2][b]Add to Your Wishlist! ✅[/b][/h2]

Are you ready to crack the case? Don’t forget to send this to your friend and start planning your strategy now! Your support means the world to us and keeps us motivated to create the best experience possible. Thank you for being part of this journey!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3062170/The_Enigma_Cases/
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121231/da8b1ca645f41cd6e8db23975ee738b39ef09715.gif[/img]

Thank you once again for being part of this journey. The mystery is far from over, and we’re just getting started.

[b]The Enigma Cases Development Team[/b]

notes.title: The Enigma Cases - Developer Diary #3
notes.content:
[url=https://discord.gg/theenigmacases][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121231/eaa26ff2ac7ba97b2321d38e64dfec1ebdeb0547.png[/img]
[/url]

[h1][b]Hello, Detectives! 🕵️‍♂️[/b][/h1]

As we approach February, we would like to extend our heartfelt thanks to all the amazing players around the world who have added The Enigma Cases to their wishlists.

As independent developers, we are working tirelessly to bring you the Demo version, and we’re thrilled to remind you that we’ll be part of Steam Next Fest February 24, 2025!

In this developer diary, we aim to offer you a sneak peek into the immersive experiences we’ve crafted for the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121231/ae1c41948bcc917d1d89c292e198cad767092b54.gif[/img]

[b]''This game is currently in development, and the visuals may change.''[/b]

[h2][b]CO-OP: Puzzles & In Voice Chat![/b][/h2]

Teamwork makes the dream work, right? Especially when you're trying to solve the case with your friends!

[h3][b]Solving a Puzzle with Your Friend! 🤝[/b][/h3]

In the demo, CO-OP will be 2 player, giving you the chance to team up and tackle challenging puzzles together. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121231/e712fe5fb4a8edd98be267ee005fdd759e212737.gif[/img]

[b]''This game is currently in development, and the visuals may change.''[/b]

[h3][b]Communication is the Key! 🎙️[/b][/h3]

We've added a walkie talkie so you can stay connected, even when far apart in-game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121231/901ede6175762a5326e6b195444bee16fbd686d9.gif[/img]

[b]''This game is currently in development, and the visuals may change.''[/b]

[h2][b]Frequently Asked Questions! ❓[/b][/h2]

[b]Question:[/b] How many players can play the demo?
[b]Answer:[/b] The demo will support 2 players.

[b]Question:[/b] How many players are planned for the full version?
[b]Answer:[/b] We plan to expand the game to support up to 4 players.

[b]Question:[/b] When will the demo be released?
[b]Answer:[/b] We plan to release the demo on February 24, 2025. Announcements regarding this will be made soon.

[b]Question:[/b] What will the process look like?
[b]Answer:[/b] During the demo phase, we will combine the feedback we gather with our roadmap to release the prologue version. After that, we plan to launch the game in Early Access.

[h2][b]Our Goals! 🗝️[/b][/h2]

The Enigma Cases is not just a game; it's a platform designed for you and your friends to experience a unique detective adventure. Our team aims to make players feel the impact of their decisions and truly become part of the story, beyond just solving puzzles.

[h2][b]Add to Your Wishlist! ✅![/b][/h2]

By adding our game to your wishlist, you’re not just showing your excitement  you’re helping us out during the development process. Your support means the world to us and keeps us motivated to create the best experience possible. Thank you for being part of this journey!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3062170/The_Enigma_Cases/
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121231/da8b1ca645f41cd6e8db23975ee738b39ef09715.gif[/img]

So why wait? Don’t forget to send this to your friend and start planning your strategy now! 🔍

[b]The Enigma Cases Development Team[/b]

notes.title: The Enigma Cases - Developer Diary #1
notes.content:
[url=https://discord.gg/theenigmacases][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121231/eaa26ff2ac7ba97b2321d38e64dfec1ebdeb0547.png[/img]
[/url]

[h1][b]Hello, Detectives! 🕵️‍♂️[/b][/h1]

In this development diary for The Enigma Cases, we want to share the game's production process and the experiences we aim to offer players.

[h2][b]Concept and Story[/b][/h2]

The Enigma Cases is a puzzle game that puts you in the shoes of a detective in 2000s America, solving mysterious murder cases with your friends. The game's atmosphere combines the nostalgic vibe of the 2000s with the popular culture of the time and detailed environmental design to provide an immersive experience.

In each case, as a detective in the Enigma Police Department, you will examine evidence, solve puzzles, and piece together clues to uncover the culprit. But remember! Your interrogations and decisions can either lead you astray or bring you one step closer to the truth.

[h2][b]Gameplay Mechanics[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Multiplayer Puzzles[/b][/h3]

Designed for a minimum of two players, The Enigma Cases requires teamwork and communication with your friends to solve puzzles. Each puzzle is designed to test your collaboration and analytical thinking skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121231/07548ce0b002c240087d937e45803bbc11a9f74b.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121231/a0c28a69ed6f35464ca5ef5e7236dcbe467e84f8.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Interactive Environment[/b][/h3]

You can use equipment in the police station, examine evidence in detail, and interact with various objects in the game world. Every corner may lead you to a clue or a hidden puzzle.

[h3][b]Interrogation and Decision-Making[/b][/h3]

Asking the right questions during interrogations is crucial. Every decision you make impacts the case-solving process.

[h3][b]2000s America[/b][/h3]

With environmental details, music, and technology from the era, we’ve worked hard to create a nostalgic atmosphere. Get ready to travel back in time and experience period-specific phones, computers, and even desktop police files.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121231/095b776a446469b78affad336e253633da3524d8.png[/img]

[h2][b]Development Process[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Atmosphere Design[/b][/h3]

When building the game world, we extensively researched the daily life and operations of police departments in the 2000s. To immerse players in the era, we took a meticulous approach to environment design and object placement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121231/56188d03ea90d3c18bc5c1c2f431cfc15d7cee6e.png[/img]

[h3][b]Puzzle Structure[/b][/h3]

Each puzzle is meaningful on its own while advancing the overarching story. Our main goal was to challenge players’ minds while ensuring the problem-solving process is enjoyable.

[h3][b]Multiplayer Dynamics[/b][/h3]

We placed great emphasis on testing to deliver smooth cooperative gameplay. Puzzles are multilayered, encouraging players to communicate effectively and approach cases from different perspectives.

[h2][b]Our Goals[/b][/h2]

The Enigma Cases is not just a game; it's a platform designed for you and your friends to experience a unique detective adventure. Our team aims to make players feel the impact of their decisions and truly become part of the story, beyond just solving puzzles.

[h2][b]Next Steps[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]New Cases[/b][/h3]

To add more variety to the game world, we are developing additional cases and puzzles. Each new case will come with fresh mechanics and surprises.

[h3][b]Feedback[/b][/h3]

Community feedback is very important to us. We want to further improve the game with your suggestions.

......

To deliver a better experience, we plan regular updates. Gather your detective friends and get ready for your first day at the Enigma Police Department! Remember, every detail is a clue. 🕵️‍♀️

See you soon!

[b]The Enigma Cases Development Team[/b]
